reviews.rationale: The Sphinx configuration opens the repository's own cli/__init__.py and searches its source text for the __version__ assignment, then assigns the captured package version to Sphinx's release and version fields. The file is build-time source metadata and the result controls documentation labels; no untrusted runtime input, authorization decision, sanitizer boundary, or security-sensitive sink is present. This is an internal documentation pattern, so it receives an evidence-backed skip rather than a product property.
